title: A Space website is served on the Space's own domain: proxy.ts routes a listed custom host to its site

source.ref: PROG-E10 phase 2 of the white label sites build (ADR-1708); lift report /mnt/project-files/white-label/2026-10-06-lift-report.md

detail: FILED 2026-10-06 as phase 2 of the white label sites build (ADR-1708). THE CONSEQUENCE: a request on a Space's own domain (spaces.domain, e.g. danieltyack.com) reached the app as if it were Frequency, so no Space could serve its website on its domain. THE FIX: proxy.ts treats any host that is not one of Frequency's own (frequencylocal.com, findafreq.com, *.vercel.app, localhost, the configured site/app URL hosts, plus an APP_HOSTS env list) as a site host (lib/sites/host.ts, pure, no database call). A host only reaches the deployment once it is added to the Vercel project, which the Domain section does (LIVE-743). On a site host, www redirects to the apex, `/` and `/<page>` rewrite to /hosted/<host>[/<page>], and deeper paths (a block's link into the app) redirect to the same path on Frequency. The site requests skip the session read and attribution entirely. /hosted resolves the Space by domain through getSpaceByDomain, so the custom_domain gate applies, and answers only when the request Host matches the path, so /hosted/<domain> on Frequency's host 404s. The render is the phase 1 SitePage with links off the domain root. An unbound host 404s on the hosted route.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const proxy=r('proxy.ts');const host=r('lib/sites/host.ts');const hosted=r('lib/sites/hosted.ts');const miss=[];if(!/routeSiteHost\(/.test(proxy))miss.push('proxy.ts does not route a custom host');if(!/export function routeSiteHost/.test(host))miss.push('there is no host router');if(!/getSpaceByDomain/.test(hosted))miss.push('the hosted route does not resolve the Space by domain');if(!fs.existsSync('app/hosted/[host]/page.tsx')||!fs.existsSync('app/hosted/[host]/[page]/page.tsx'))miss.push('there is no hosted site route');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-742: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Measures the consequence at its seams: proxy.ts sends a listed custom host through the host router, the router exists, and the hosted route resolves the Space by domain (custom_domain gate) and serves Home and custom pages. Failed on main before this change (no host awareness in proxy.ts, no hosted route). The routing behaviour itself is unit-tested in lib/sites/host.test.ts.
